images.filename: Enemy Activities - Destruction by Enemy in U.S. - Enemy operations in the U.S. Kingsland, New Jersey munitions plant explosion - NARA - 31478090.jpg
images.caption:
Scope and content:  Original Caption: Enemy operations in the U.S. Kingsland, New Jersey munitions plant explosion. Photo shows the hill which is said to have been the only thing that saved the New Jersey towns of Kingsland and Rotherford from probable destruction by exploding munitions from the ammunition factory which blew up. Photo also shows the ruins of the plant which had almost finished a $100,000,000 contract of shells for the Russian Government. This contract had kept the plant busy for the previous two years.
Photographer: Underwood and Underwood
